scope: classic dense MLA single-token latent core; optional declared head up-projection
layout: contiguous CUDA tensors, all FP16 pointers aligned to 16 bytes
page_table: host int32-compatible metadata, no cross-request overlapping pages, exact ceil(length/page_size) pages

outputs.optional_layer_Y: float32 [B,H,128], Z cast FP32 times actual quantized U_V cast FP32, TF32 disabled

mask: single-token query observes all existing valid KV entries
rope: explicit token positions, interleaved, theta=10000, no implicit repeat rotation at cache append
reference: trusted controller CPU FP64 from actual quantized q_abs/q_rope/cache inputs, natural-log LSE; full-layer absorption identity is separately tested before q_abs requantization

comparison.rule: every finite element abs(actual-reference)<=atol+rtol*abs(reference); empty LSE mask exact

source.sm89_environment: Torch2.7.1/CUDA12.6 original C++17 SDK, pending actual validation
